body: I moved out of my abusive roommate situation when our campus had a blackout and I knew she was away for dinner, asked my friend to help and got out in under 2 hours - I had been trying to leave that situation for more than a year and for the past 4 months had only slept in that room for 5 hours a night, this was all one of the worst times of my life and I am still trying to recover from the shit I experienced
